name: Loop Video + Gắn đếm ngược
description: Moi file trong Kho video doc ra mot output: lap hinh va lap tieng toi mot thoi luong dich, va de video dem nguoc (da tach nen) len tren. Vi tri va co cua dem nguoc chinh bang khung xem truoc keo tha.
_ghi_chu_o_nhap: Hai o Nhac / Video dem nguoc nhan CA duong dan file LAN duong dan thu muc. Ly do: ba o trong giong het nhau ma o dau tien (Kho video doc) LA thu muc that, nen dua vao thu muc la phan xa rat tu nhien - da xay ra 2026-09-08. Nhung THU MUC NHIEU FILE thi hai o hieu KHAC nhau, va khac co ly do: voi NHAC, nhieu file nghia la moi video mot bai, xoay vong theo thu tu ten (ADR-026); voi DEM NGUOC thi van la loi, vi ca me chi ghep duoc mot dem nguoc nen boc bua la doan mo.
_ghi_chu_tu_tao: Che do 'Tu tao theo thoi luong dich' ve mot FILE dem nguoc nen trong suot (1 fps) roi day vao dung duong ong nhu file nguoi dung chon - nen khung keo tha can chinh dung duoc y nguyen. KHONG ve thang bang drawtext len tung khung: do 2026-09-08 tren video that 1080x1920 60fps, dau ra 3 tieng, drawtext ve thang mat 90 PHUT con tao file roi ghep chi mat 36 PHUT (nhanh gap 2,5 lan), vi drawtext phai dung chu cho 648.000 khung con file tao san chi co 10.800 khung. Khung ve duoc do THAT bang kenh alpha roi moi cat dung co, chu khong uoc luong be rong theo so ky tu - doan sai thi hoac cat mat chu hoac de thua vien trong suot lam khung keo tha to hon phan nhin thay. Bieu thuc dem nguoc da duoc doi chieu tung pixel voi anh tham chieu: khop 0 pixel sai o moi moc, ke ca cho doi gio. LUU Y: dem nguoc tu tao doi so moi giay suot ca video nen KHONG dung duoc thu thuat chu ky - buoc phai ma hoa het chieu dai. Dung file dem nguoc LAP LAI (vd dong ho 1 phut) thi nhanh hon nhieu.
_ghi_chu_kieu_chu: Day chi la MAC DINH. Moi tham so o duoi deu chinh duoc ngay trong khung 'Xem truoc & can chinh' (bang kieu chu ben phai), roi di sang Python qua o an #ovlStyle dang JSON - dung tien le #ovlPlace. Gia tri hong thi lay lai mac dinh o day chu KHONG chan ca me: day la tham so trinh bay, khong dang de dung mot me chay hang tieng. Be day cua vien/bong/dem nen deu duoc nhan theo co chu (moc 140px), nen doi gen_font_size chi doi DO NET chu khong doi kieu dang.
_ghi_chu_bong: TAT tu 2026-09-09 theo yeu cau nguoi dung. Luu y kem: khong bong va khong vien thi chu trang se KHO DOC tren nen sang. Neu gap canh do, bat vien den mong (gen_border_width 4-6) doc hon han bong lech - do la cach cac dai truyen hinh van dung. Kieu mau 'Trang vien den' trong khung xem truoc lam san dieu nay bang mot cu nhan.
_ghi_chu_hop_nen: Hop nen mo la cach de doc nhat tren nen roi ram. gen_box_pad tinh bang px o moc co chu 140.
_ghi_chu_do_mo: Do mo KHONG duoc ve vao chu ma ap o BUOC GHEP bang colorchannelmixer=aa. Hai ly do, ca hai do duoc 2026-09-09 tren chinh ffmpeg di kem: (a) 'alpha=' va 'fontcolor=...@' cua drawtext BINH PHUONG gia tri khi ve len nen trong suot - yeu cau 0,5 ra alpha 64 chu khong phai 128, tuc thanh truot 50% cho ra 25%; colorchannelmixer thi tuyen tinh chuan (0,75->191, 0,5->128, 0,25->64). (b) Dat o buoc ghep thi no ap duoc cho CA file dem nguoc nguoi dung tu chon, khong chi cho ban tu tao.
_ghi_chu_dinh_dang: auto = hh:mm:ss neu dich tu 1 tieng tro len, khong thi mm:ss. 'mmss' ep mm:ss ke ca khi dai hon 1 tieng (90 phut ra '90:00' chu khong phai '01:30:00'). 'ss' chi hien so giay con lai.
_ghi_chu_tach_nen: Phan lon video 'dem nguoc tach nen' tim duoc tren mang thuc ra la dong ho TRANG TREN NEN DEN trong mot file .mp4 - KHONG co kenh alpha. Ghep thang thi no de mot hop den kin len video. 'auto' se: (a) thay kenh alpha -> dung thang; (b) khong co alpha nhung 4 goc deu toi hon black_threshold -> tu tach mau den bang colorkey; (c) khong co alpha va nen khong phai den -> BAO LOI ro rang thay vi cho ra ket qua hong am tham. Dat 'alpha' de ep dung thang, 'black' de ep tach den, hoac mot ma mau ('0x00FF00') de tach phong nen xanh. Do 2026-09-08 tren file that: colorkey giu nguyen mau nen ben duoi (59,89,199 so voi goc 60,90,200) va chi 0,8% pixel bi lam toi; blend 'screen'/'lighten' thi LAM HONG MAU (ra 190,24,255) vi no tron tren tung mat phang YUV chu khong phai RGB - dung thu lai.
_ghi_chu_vi_tri: x/y = goc tren-trai cua dem nguoc, tinh theo TI LE chieu rong/cao video goc. w = ti le chieu rong. Dung ti le chu khong dung pixel de mot khung canh chinh dung duoc cho ca kho video co do phan giai khac nhau.
_ghi_chu_chu_ky: Ghep overlay BUOC BUOC ma hoa lai - khong the '-c copy' nhu Loop Video thuong. Do 2026-09-08 tren 1080x1920 voi h264_nvenc: 3,13x thoi gian thuc, tuc 58 PHUT cho mot video 3 tieng. Nen app ma hoa dung MOT chu ky roi lap ban da ma hoa bang concat demuxer + '-c:v copy' (776x thoi gian thuc). Chu ky = boi chung nho nhat cua so khung video goc va so khung dem nguoc, nen ca hai deu ve dung diem xuat phat o moi mo noi - khong co vet nhay. Tinh bang SO KHUNG (so nguyen) chu khong bang giay (so thuc) de khong tich luy sai so qua hang tram vong.
_ghi_chu_keo_gian: Chu ky chi ngan khi do dai video goc va do dai dem nguoc tinh co chia het cho nhau - ma ngoai doi thi hiem. Do tren file that 2026-09-08: video goc 20,00s va dem nguoc 59,72s cho boi chung 4,3 TRIEU khung, tuc khong bao gio dung duoc, va mot video 3 tieng phai ma hoa thang mat 4,6 GIO. Keo gian dem nguoc 59,72s -> 60,00s (0,47%, khong the nhan ra bang mat) thi chu ky con 60 giay va cung video do mat khoang MOT PHUT. Nen mac dinh BAT, nhung co nguong stretch_tolerance va LUON ghi he so vao log. Dat false neu dem nguoc cua ban la bo dem that su can dung tung giay.
_ghi_chu_tieng: Toan bo chi phi buoc lap nam o ma hoa AAC: chep luong hinh 776x, chep luong tieng 851x, nhung ma hoa AAC chi 7,9x (tu wav) den 15,1x (tu mp3). Nen ban nhac dai du moc duoc dung DUNG MOT LAN CHO CA ME roi chep luong vao tung video - ca me dung chung mot file nhac va mot moc thoi gian. Dung mot lan chu khong noi cac doan AAC da ma hoa: noi kieu do de lai vet lom bien do o moi cho noi (do duoc: RMS 2895 -> 1833).
_ghi_chu_alpha: Da kiem chung tren ffmpeg 2018 di kem (2026-09-08): .mov QuickTime RLE va .mov ProRes 4444 deu ghep dung - overlay hien, nen lot qua vung trong suot. .webm VP8/VP9 alpha CHUA kiem chung duoc vi chinh ban ffmpeg nay khong tao noi file thu co alpha. Voi .webm app them '-c:v libvpx-vp9' truoc input do, vi bo giai ma vp9 goc cua ffmpeg bo kenh alpha con libvpx thi giu.
_ghi_chu_xem_truoc: Anh xem truoc di sang giao dien duoi dang DATA URI nhung vao thang trang, KHONG phai duong dan 'file://'. pywebview phuc vu index.html qua mot HTTP server cuc bo nen trang co nguon goc http://127.0.0.1:<cong>, va trinh duyet chan moi tai nguyen file:// - khung xem truoc se den si ma khong bao loi gi. Preset 'Tai thumbnail Youtube' da phai chuyen sang 'data' vi dung ly do nay tu truoc.
